summary: Three distilled pile-design reports (PileDesignEndBentOne, PileDesignEndBentTwo, PileDesignPier; 19 October 2026 cases, decision D-054) are appended to the journal as registered modules and linked from the PedBridge index under Specific calculations and foundations. The reports read no other journal module: every input is a literal from the notebook case, with its source. All other components are byte identical.
published_outputs: PileDesignEndBentOne and PileDesignEndBentTwo (18 in square prestressed concrete piles, Standard Plans Index 455-018, 12 x 0.6 in strands, 18 tons of downdrag per pile as a drag load): Status (current distilled result: All Checks Pass), the DC_* demand/capacity ratios with their Chk_* result strings, DC_max and DC_ymax. Structural D/C 0.550 (End Bent 1) and 0.557 (End Bent 2)
PileDesignPier (20 in x 0.48 in steel pipe piles, noncomposite, no downdrag): Status (current distilled result: All Checks Pass), the DC_* ratios with their Chk_* strings. Structural D/C 0.457

Distilled numerical checks only, not design acceptance. Each report lists its pending items: downdrag source documentation, pile-to-cap connection, pipe steel grade and corrosion allowance (Pier), minimum tip elevation, scour, drivability, environment classification and FBMP export currency
assumptions_and_conventions: The reports are the Blockpad edition of the notebook cases of decision D-054, built by scripts/build_pile_bpad.py from pile_design/bpad.py; the source reports and cases are in project_current/pile_design/ (10-19). The FBMP demands are the D-049 fixed-run exports (End Bent 1_Fixed.XML, End Bent 2_Fixed.XML, Pier_Fixed.XML), read by the notebook, not live in Blockpad

Blockpad has no vector variables: record and strand vectors become scalars ending _1 ... _6 (_4 for the pier) and _1 ... _12. Each equation is shown once for record 1 and strand 1; the other records are in collapsed sections and green tables. See pile_bpad/README.md

The two 121-point interaction sweeps are not formulas: Figure 2 is a native canvas drawn from the notebook's resolved curve points and does not move when an input changes. M_r_P0, P_r_rs and M_r_rs (values the Mathcad sheet finds by a search over the sweep) are amber inputs read from the notebook; the equations that use them are live

Status = If(DC_max <= 1, ...). The pile spacing check is exactly 1.0 (3 diameters) for these piles, so DC_max <= 1 holds only because the quotient is exactly 1 in floating point; rebuild after any change there
Added reports are bare fragments from pile_bpad/fragments (LF line endings, 2-space indent) appended unchanged; the rest of the journal is CRLF. PedBridge keeps its CRLF line endings
downstream_impact: No existing component reads the new names; check reports no detected downstream impact
The existing pile records (PileProperties, FBMPEndBent, FBMPPier, FoundationModeling) are not changed or reconciled with the new reports
The reports use the journal's existing document-level PASS and FAIL rules, the All Checks Pass / There are FAILURES colour rules and the Result only style; no style, resource or include was added
external_analysis: FB-MultiPier models and results (D-049 fixed-run exports) were read by the notebook and not re-run. The pile heads, loads and soil records are those of the exports; their currency against the final design (COH-013, COH-028) is not asserted and is listed as a pending prerequisite in each report. LRFD and SDG checks were recomputed by the notebook's own evaluator.
